a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost guarantees we both get caught at 0 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than surprise you. I know this departs from our agreement, and I'm sorry. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. If we both took, the split is random. Either way, from now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so you can rebuild to 4. If I ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
